text:
maria: Quick flag — console is surfacing a bunch of v1 tenants with a new 'compat-risk' badge. Some of them also show zero deprecation opt-out telemetry. Not sure if that's a UI bug or missing signal from routing. :eyes:

jess: Is this the same cohort we saw in last week's quota-delta alert?

maria: Looks overlapping but not identical. Quota deltas were per-route; this is per-tenant in the console.

akash: FWIW we've seen header-negotiation fallthroughs where the client sends both X-Client-Version and X-Compat, backend picks one and the other path doesn't emit the deprec_optout metric. That will make the console count appear lower.

sam: Ugh. So two different codepaths, one increments `deprec_optout` and the other doesn't?

akash: Yeah. Roughly: legacy proxy path increments meter_a, v2 router path increments meter_b. Console currently reads only meter_a when building the badge.

jess: Can we make console join both meters or normalize to a single metric name?

akash: Short-term: join both. Long-term: align emission to `platform.deprec.optout` from the router code.

maria: For rollout/UX we should also surface sampling rate and last-sample-time next to the badge so PMs understand noise.

sam: Agree. Also need a way to mark tenants as exemptions so the badge doesn't trigger alerts for orgs that opted into a private migration plan.

maria: Proposal: add an `exemptions` flag in tenant metadata + show an `exempt` pill on console. Exemptions should be write-protected (console-admin role) and audit-logged.

jess: Sounds reasonable. Telemetry team: can we backfill optout counts for last 30d when we align metrics? If not, show a "data incomplete" hint.

akash: Backfill is possible but heavy. I'd vote for alignment and a one-time backfill for flagged tenants only. We can run an ETL over logs with a date range.

sam: For rollout, suggest a 3-step plan: 1) console reads both meters + show provisional counts; 2) add exemptions UI + audit logs; 3) switch console to canonical metric after one-week validation + optional backfill.

maria: Can someone post a quick config snippet for the provisional sampling UI so designers can mock?

akash: Here's a minimal config we'd ship to console-feature-flags service (example):

```
{
  "deprec_badge": {
    "enabled": true,
    "join_meters": ["meter_a","meter_b"],
    "sampling_pct": 5,
    "show_provisional": true
  }
}
```

jess: Nice. For telemetry, sampling_pct=5 is fine for initial probe. We'll need to ensure metrics aggregation windows are aligned (1m windows).

deploy-bot: deploy initiated: console-feature-flags v2026.03.21-probe -> canary (5%) :rocket:

sam: I'll pick up the exemptions API + console pill. Will add an admin check and audit log entry.

akash: I'll open a router PR to emit `platform.deprec.optout` and a short-lived shim to increment meter_b until rollout complete.

maria: Jess, can you coordinate telemetry backfill scope with infra? Start with tenants that currently have the badge + nonzero quota-delta.

jess: On it. I'll create the infra ticket and tag you all.

maria: Great — tentative timeline: canary probe today, exemptions UI + API in 3 days, canonical metric switch in 10 after we validate. If anything blocks, ping #release-war-room. :+1:
